name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
summary: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at the post-matriculation level. Includes maintenance allowance (hosteller/day-scholar) and reimbursement of non-refundable fees, subject to parental income limits.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
The applicant must have passed matriculation (Class 10) and be pursuing post-matriculation studies.
Parental/guardian annual income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.

entitlement_rules.text: Hostellers receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,200 per month (Rs. 13,500 per year including book grant).
Day scholars receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 700 per month (Rs. 7,500 per year including book grant).

appeal_hierarchy.description: First-level grievance at the educational institute.
Escalation to the state welfare department.
